title: Earthy Flaky Malaysian Medjool Dates Satay
description: A post-workout Malaysian dish that brings together the earthy sweetness of Medjool dates with the flaky crunch of KFC-style fried tofu. Perfect for a satisfying afternoon snack or light lunch.
instructions: Mix the soy sauce, rice vinegar, ginger paste, garlic paste, coriander powder, cumin powder, turmeric powder, and black pepper in a bowl to create the marinade.
Add the tofu to the marinade and let it sit for at least 30 minutes, flipping occasionally.
Cut the Medjool dates in half and remove the pits.
Heat 2 tablespoons of coconut oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the tofu to the pan and fry until golden brown on both sides, about 5-7 minutes per side.
Remove the tofu from the pan and set it aside to rest.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of coconut oil to the pan and fry the Medjool dates until caramelized and slightly charred, about 3-5 minutes per side.
Serve the fried tofu and Medjool dates together, garnished with sliced cucumber if desired, and a sprinkle of palm sugar on top.
Double fry the tofu for an extra crispy exterior: after the first fry, let the tofu rest for 10 minutes before re-frying at 350F (175C) for 5-7 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
